locations.name: The studio
locations.description: A long table under daylight, covered with a paper strip, card benches and a small card cabin.

locations.name: The building hall
locations.description: A covered yard hall with building blocks set out along its floor and a steel template leaning against the wall.

locations.name: The ferry's hall
locations.description: The covered passenger hall inside the ferry, one long space under its roof, its sides a row of openings between posts and its floor clear from side to side.

locations.name: The fitting-out quay
locations.description: A working quay with bollards along its edge and a gangway landing beside the berth.

locations.name: The home pier
locations.description: A public pier with a long boarding edge and a waiting area beside it.

locations.name: The far pier
locations.description: The pier across the harbour, with its own boarding edge and waiting area.
